blocks.text: Why you pay EMI for 5 years but your loan amount barely drops.
In the early years, 80% of your EMI is just Interest. You pay the Principal last.
The Fix: Pre-pay 1 extra EMI every year. You will close a 20-year loan in 12 years.

summary: Why your EMI barely dents the principal in year one — and the one prepayment habit that fixes it.
title: The EMI Trap
